item.subject: maths
item.stem:
In the diagram, lines $p$ and $q$ are parallel and transversal $t$ crosses them. Angle $a$ measures $70^{\circ}$. Angle $b$ is alternate to angle $a$.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Angle $b$ equals $70^{\circ}$ because alternate angles are equal when the lines are parallel.
options.B: Angle $b$ equals $70^{\circ}$ even if $p$ and $q$ are not parallel.
options.C: Parallel lines are produced by equal alternate angles, so the equality creates the parallel pair.
options.D: The same equality holds for any two lines cut by a transversal, parallel or not.
